evidence.dominant_driver: Retail sales rose 1.2% m/m versus 0.8% expected, with control-group sales +1.4%; resilient demand reinforces Fed tightening pressure but the release is stale at decision time.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: Fed 25bp hike was already overwhelmingly priced before the release.

absorption.reason: Release is more than four hours old; equities subsequently traded higher and yields/oil eased. Forecast targets only residual move from decision time.

evidence.decision_notes: Delayed data-release story. Residual forecast from 16:59:08Z, immediately before the 18:00Z FOMC decision; Fed event risk dominates 15m/1h.
